name: fin-observer
description: 经济舆情监控平台：订阅股票/ETF → 关键字爬虫 → 结构化事件识别 → 相关度评分 → 资金走向与预测信号

scripts.dev: pnpm build:core && concurrently -n api,crawler,web -c blue,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @fin/api start:dev" "pnpm --filter @fin/crawler start:dev" "pnpm --filter @fin/web dev"
scripts.dev:server: pnpm build:core && concurrently -n api,crawler -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @fin/api start:dev" "pnpm --filter @fin/crawler start:dev"
